top_signals.title: US, Iran Explore Hormuz Deal, Trump-Xi Summit Short on Substance
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Mark Haefele, UBS Global Wealth Management CIO; Diana Choyleva, Enodo Economics Chief Economist; Steve Tsang, SOAS University of London Director of the China Institute (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PaxOcean to Build Ulstein-Designed SOV for NYK
top_signals.summary: NYK Line has ordered a new service operation vessel (SOV) from PaxOcean Group for offshore wind projects in Taiwan and the wider Asia-Pacific region, with delivery planned around 2029.PaxOcean will build the vessel at its Graha yard in Batam…

top_signals.title: Zambia Says Diesel Pipeline Open Access to Resume by January
top_signals.summary: Zambia will return to allowing open access to the land-locked nation’s sole fuel-import pipeline by January, a senior official said, suggesting a delay to meeting a key ask from the International Monetary Fund.
